Batch 1 of the 1924-10-13 時文社 first edition of 金剛山遊記 (南大門驛에서高山에, up to the 末輝嶺), one sentence or verse line per item; the scan is not in the repo. Hanja were checked against the scan column by column on 2026-11-21 by a single reader with no second source. Hangul spelling is approximate: the print's ㅅ-clusters (ᄭ ᄯ ᄲ) are written as plain syllables, and 働 塲 釗 items are left out because the Hangul form cannot be derived. Score the Hanja runs; Hangul orthography noise can affect word boundaries.

Batch 2 of the 1924-10-13 時文社 first edition of 金剛山遊記 (長安寺, 靈源洞ㅣ望軍臺, 萬瀑洞 up to 愒惺樓), one sentence or verse line per item; the scan is not in the repo. Hanja checked against the scan column by column on 2026-11-21 by a single reader with no second source; Hangul spelling is approximate (the print's ㅅ-clusters are written as plain syllables). Items with the Chinese quotations (14 or more Hanja in a row) and with characters whose reading cannot be derived (働 塲 釗 愒 蜓 崙 躊 軟) are left out. Readings of 里 after a numeral, 林, 簾, 朗 and 兜率 were corrected by hand where the derivation was wrong; batch 1 had the same corrections applied in this change.

Batch 3 of the 1924-10-13 時文社 first edition of 金剛山遊記 (萬瀑洞, 白雲臺·船庵·須彌庵), one sentence or verse line per item; same method and limits as batch 2 (single reader, Hanja checked against the scan, approximate Hangul, quotations and unreadable-character items left out).
